faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Message me on Facebook, text, or use the quote form on this page. Send photos of the space, what you want painted, and your timeline. I follow up with a free quote and next steps. Quotes are in writing, so there's a record of exactly what's included.

faq.q: How long does a job take?
faq.a: A single room is usually 1 to 2 days. A full interior is usually 3 to 7 days depending on size, prep, and drying time. You get a clear timeline before work starts.

faq.q: Do you move furniture and protect my home?
faq.a: Yes. Furniture is moved and covered, floors are protected, trim is taped and masked, and drop cloths are used throughout. Cleanup is daily, with a final walkthrough with you.

Quality, low-odor paints suited for the surface. Tell me if you have kids, pets, or sensitivities and I'll pick the right product. If you already have a color, send it and I'll match it. For low-odour interior work I'll suggest zero-VOC options, which is worth it in an Edmonton winter when windows stay shut.

faq.q: Do you supply the paint or do I?
faq.a: Either works. I can price the job with materials included (I use trade-grade lines I trust) or work on labour-only with your paint. Supplies are a genuine choice, not an upsell.
Yes. I can help you narrow down 2 to 3 colors that work with your lighting and flooring, and test swatches on the wall before we commit.
Yes. Daily cleanup, plus a full final cleanup. Paint cans, tape, and drop cloths are removed. You come home to a finished room, not a job site.

faq.q: Can you fix drywall before painting?
faq.a: Yes — patching, filling nail pops, taping minor cracks and sanding are standard prep in my quotes. Larger drywall sections I'll flag honestly if a drywall specialist makes more sense.

Yes — I'm based in west-central Edmonton and regularly work in St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Leduc, Beaumont and Fort Saskatchewan. Travel within the Edmonton metro is included in quotes.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: Interior work can often start within a couple of weeks. Exterior work in Edmonton is weather-dependent — May through September fills up first, so book exterior repaints ahead of the season.
